environment.databasePolicy: Every service uses createLocalServer with an explicit newly-created temporary SQLite path. The default .local-data is never used.
environment.syncDevices: Two or more isolated browser contexts on this one machine, not physical devices.
environment.deterministicResources: Workflow tests stub external raster tiles and fonts. The public-network smoke runs separately without these stubs.

runs.explanation: All four failures were the fault-injection proxy: its original Origin differed from the strict upstream origin, and its chunked transfer of the immutable large JSON produced ERR_CACHE_WRITE_FAILURE in this environment. Direct-server SW loading and offline reload passed.

The trusted fixture maps only its own same-origin header to the upstream origin and sends the exact length of its already buffered response bytes. No production security or cache behavior was relaxed.

runs.evidence: After check-in and return to a new Explore map, eight OpenStreetMap tile responses were HTTP 200 and all eight tile images decoded with naturalWidth > 0; no detailed-map loading or retry notice remained.

syncScenarios: Pre-sync local records and original IndexedDB photo bytes remain intact; metadata migration copy is retained; local public flag remains local and newly restored photos are private.
Two offline isolated contexts record the same landmark, then merge to two visits and one regional entitlement with both photos intact.
A POST committed by SQLite but whose response is lost is replayed after browser refresh with the same durable request ID, without duplicate records.
A new local check-in created during synchronization survives the older response and is subsequently synchronized.
Stopping and recreating the local server/database connection at the same port with the same temporary file preserves saved data and retries an offline outbox.
Failed photo download remains pending, does not claim success, and recovers with valid photo bytes after retry and refresh.
local-a and local-b remain isolated, unknown foreign photos return 404, binding cannot be changed in place, and pause/resume does not delete data.
Identical request-ID replay is idempotent; the same request ID with different payload returns 409 without changing the database.
A new request ID cannot silently overwrite the immutable evidence of an existing visit; conflict returns 409.
Missing photo returns 422 and remains retryable; sequence 3 followed by 2 preserves the union; replay returns the current union; photo and receipt namespaces remain space-local.

evidence.note: Representative evidence is committed here; full per-case captures remain in the local temporary QA directory.

remainingLimits: Local loopback verification only: no cloud account, credentials, public deployment or production authentication. Local space names are test namespaces, not access-control credentials.
Isolated browser contexts simulate multiple devices. Physical phones, real camera/GPS, field arrival points and geographic boundary calibration were not tested.
Same-browser multi-tab concurrency is outside this agreed test scope.
Persistence was verified by closing and recreating the service/database connection; OS crashes, sudden power loss and filesystem failure were not simulated.
Offline app/map behavior requires a successful prior shell cache. External detailed map tiles are intentionally not stored for offline use.
